LanguageData.Lumen_Aegite_WardRule: Only the strongest covering ward tier services each fire or filth target, and among equal tiers only one ward does. Overlapping wards add nothing.
LanguageData.Lumen_Aegite_FireRule: Each pulse suppresses owned fires instead of thinning filth.
LanguageData.Lumen_Aegite_WardRadiusDesc: Works indoors, outdoors and through walls.
LanguageData.Lumen_Aegite_FilthThinnedDesc: Used when there is no fire to suppress, or the Solar active effect can't run.
